Subject: Scheduling — end-to-end demo + security checklist (ApexGrid)

Hi Alicia / Mark —

Thanks again for the productive discovery call. Per our conversation, we'd like to run a 60–75 minute end-to-end demo that touches the hosted API + private deployment flow, and to walk your security and procurement teams through the controls and SOC material. Proposed attendees from our side: me (AE), Stephanie (SE, runtime walkthrough), Olga (security TL for privacy controls), and Karthik (procurement lead for contract questions).

Proposed slots next week (PST):
- Tue 2027-04-06 10:30–11:45
- Wed 2027-04-07 13:00–14:15

I've attached a mutual action plan and a short runbook so security can pre-review. Can you confirm which slot works for procurement and security, and whether you need any additional evidence ahead of time?

Attachments: RDW-5781_mutual_action_plan.xlsx (xlsx), demo-runbook.md (md)

Thanks,
Marcus
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: Scheduling — end-to-end demo + security checklist (ApexGrid)

Hey Marcus —

Thanks for the proposed times. Quick updates from our side:
- Procurement has a standing review on Tue morning, so Tue 10:30 won't work.
- Security asked for a SOC2 summary and a short list of data retention and logging settings before the walkthrough; they said they need 48 hours to triage.
- Also, two of our engineers will be at an offsite all day Wed (unexpected travel), so Wed 13:00 is also tight.

Can we aim for Thu 2027-04-08 11:00–12:15 PT instead? If not, we may need to push into next week. Please confirm whether you can provide the SOC2 summary separately (PDF) and a condensed demo that focuses on hosted API first — procurement prefers to see the pricing/terms front-loaded.

Thanks,
Alicia
Director, Platform Partnerships | ApexGrid
Alicia.Vega@apexgrid.io
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Vega <alicia.vega@apexgrid.io>, Mark Sutherland <mark.sutherland@apexgrid.io>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-02T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling — end-to-end demo + security checklist (ApexGrid)

Alicia —

Appreciate the heads up. Two quick notes and a proposal:

1) SOC2 summary: Olga — attaching the one-page SOC2_summary.pdf here. It's a high-level extract of our attestation and the controls most commonly requested (encryption, key management, access reviews, logging). Olga will be available on the call for any follow-ups.

Attachment: SOC2_summary.pdf (pdf)

2) Staffing constraint: Stephanie just flagged that she's scheduled for customer travel on Thu morning, so she can't do Thu 11:00. We can either:
   - Move the full team demo to Mon 2027-04-12 (best-case, full coverage), or
   - Run a condensed hosted-API-first demo on Thu 2027-04-08 11:00 with Marcus + Karthik, and have Stephanie do a follow-up deep-dive for the private deployment the following week.

3) Procurement preference: we can begin the session with a 15-20 minute pricing/terms section. Karthik, can you prepare the short pricing summary for Thu if we go the condensed route?

Please confirm which option you prefer. If Thu 11:00 still works for procurement/security for a hosted-first demo, we'll lock it and circulate calendar invites. If not, we'll target Mon 2027-04-12.

Thanks —
Marcus

On a related note, Evelyn Hart (our Head of Sales Ops) is cc'd because if we need to rearrange Stephanie's schedule she may reassign another SE to keep momentum. If you have any SE preferences let us know.
From: Mark Sutherland <mark.sutherland@apexgrid.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Alicia Vega <alicia.vega@apexgrid.io>
Cc: procurement@apexgrid.io, security-team@apexgrid.io, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T16:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling — Scheduling — end-to-end demo + security checklist (ApexGrid)

Marcus / team —

Thanks for the SOC2 summary, Olga — that cleared the initial triage for security. We spoke with procurement and the consensus is:
- We'll take the condensed hosted-API-first demo on Thu 2027-04-08 11:00–12:15 PT. Please start with a 20-minute pricing/terms overview.
- Procurement will send a short PO template to Karthik after the session.
- Security will join the first 30 minutes and may follow up with a quick questionnaire after the demo.

One operational ask: Stephanie is the preferred SE, but if travel blocks her we are fine with a handoff to Olga for the private deployment deep-dive; for the hosted demo, a host from Redwood who can run the live API call sequences is required.

Confirmed attendees from ApexGrid: Alicia, Mark, 2x procurement (as needed), 1x security engineer.

Please circulate the calendar invite with a short agenda and the dial-in link. Also, thanks for flagging the alternate Mon 2027-04-12 in case something else pops.

Best,
Mark
Sr. Product Ops Manager | ApexGrid
mark.sutherland@apexgrid.io

On Thu we'll kick off with pricing (Karthik), quick hosted API demo (Marcus), then transfer to SE deep-dive follow-up (Stephanie or Olga) if needed.
